From: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>

Subject: Calibration: Senior Inference Engineer — leveling guardrails & debrief playbook

Team —

We have Angela Park (ref attached CV) moving to on-site/hybrid loop next week. Before we lock panels and slots I want a short alignment on: role scope, leveling anchors (Sr vs Staff boundaries), and how we run the debrief so signals are consistent across panels. Goal: avoid last-minute regrades and minimize variance between panels.

Please review the proposed scorecard (attached) and the two candidate-anchor questions doc. Key items I want us to settle by EOD Wed:
- 3 core success signals for the role (must/have/bonus)
- Clear examples that separate Senior from Staff (concrete tradeoffs)
- Bar-raiser for this loop (who will own cross-panel veto?)
- Interview sloting and debrief cadence (30m panel debrief vs full calibration 60m)

Suggested signals (draft):
1) Production inference system design: demonstrates choices for latency/cost tradeoffs.
2) Model-serving troubleshooting: root-cause a regression and describe mitigations.
3) Cross-functional collaboration + mentorship: evidence of driving design tradeoffs with product/infra.

If you disagree with any of those, call it out and propose an alternative with an example. I put the scorecard template and anchor questions in the thread.

Attachments: scorecard-template.xlsx, anchor-questions.docx, Angela_Park_CV.pdf

Thanks — can we sync briefly 9:30 PT tomorrow if needed?
— Priyom
Engineering Manager, Inference Serving
Redwood Inference
From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Calibration: Senior Inference Engineer — leveling guardrails & debrief playbook

Thanks Priyom — quick notes:

On signals:
- I agree with the three. To separate Sr vs Staff I suggest we use concrete scale examples:
  * Sr: owns a service-level optimization (e.g., 40% token-cost reduction for one product path) and can explain kernel/quantization tradeoffs at 1,000 qps.
  * Staff: designed cross-service routing, shaped backbone caching strategies, and proposed rollout with fallback policies across regions.

Bar-raiser: I nominate Markus as bar-raiser for this loop. He should focus on system-level tradeoffs and cross-panel consistency.

Debrief flow proposal (to be short and actionable):
- 5m each panel quick signal highlights (what they saw)
- 10m scoring discussion (calibrate on each core signal)
- 5m final consensus + action items (hire/no-hire/hold)

I uploaded a short sample rubric in the Drive link (see related_links). If everyone agrees I'll mark the Staff anchor examples in the scorecard.

— Lauren
Director, ML Platforms
From: markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Calibration: Senior Inference Engineer — leveling guardrails & debrief playbook

Happy to take bar-raiser. A few operational asks:

1) Panel composition — keep at most one Senior+Reviewer who has direct inference-serving interview experience; mix with a product or infra partner to assess cross-functional tradeoffs.
2) Time allocation per panel: 45m interview, 15m buffer for quick notes.
3) Scoring: use 1-4 per signal (1=insufficient, 4=clear) and capture one sentence evidence per score. The scorecard template enforces that.

On leveling examples: attach two short callouts in anchor-questions.docx showing how to score an answer about caching vs KV eviction.

I'll be reachable for the debrief — propose a 60m calibration after the last panel (we can cancel earlier if consensus is strong).

Attachments: anchor-questions.docx, scorecard-template.xlsx

-Markus
Staff Engineer, Serving Runtime

Thanks all — quick summary and decisions: 

Decisions made:
- Core signals finalized: Production inference design, Troubleshooting & mitigation, Cross-functional impact/mentorship.
- Staff vs Senior anchors added to scorecard (I annotated the template). Senior = strong ownership of a service; Staff = cross-service design + rollout leadership.
- Bar-raiser: Markus Klein. He will call across-panel consistency and has final say on ambiguous borderline cases.
- Panel timing: 45m interview + 15m buffer as proposed.
- Debrief: 60m immediately after last panel on Thu 2027-03-25 at 16:00 PT (calendar link in related_links). Please block even if you think you won't need it; we will cancel if consensus is immediate.

Next actions (owners):
- Samantha (TalentLoop): finalize schedule & confirm candidate buffers (Samantha).
- Markus: add two example scoring snippets to anchor-questions.docx (Markus).
- Lauren: review Staff anchor edits in the scorecard (Lauren).
- Marissa: pick product partner and update panel roster (Marissa).

I'll run the first 10m of the debrief to ensure cross-panel signals are captured and we reach a decision quickly. Thanks for the quick turn on this.
